how_to_apply: Visit the Goa Housing Board website at www.ghb.goa.gov.in or the Government portal to download the prescribed application format.
Fill out the application form completely in block letters in your own handwriting.
Affix a passport size photograph on the application form and put your signature half on the photograph and half on the form.

Attach self-attested copies of required certificates including Birth Certificate, qualification certificates, 15 years Residence Certificate in Goa, Employment Card, Aadhaar Card, Experience Certificate, and EWS Certificate if applicable.
Ensure all fields are correctly filled and required documents are enclosed.

Submit the application in the prescribed format by post or hand delivery to the Managing Director, Goa Housing Board, Building 'A', 2nd Floor, New Market Complex, Porvorim, Bardez, Goa - 403521 latest by 29 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Goa Housing Board
content_sections.text: Visit the Goa Housing Board website at www.ghb.goa.gov.in or the Government portal to download the prescribed application format. Fill out the application form completely in block letters in your own handwriting. Affix a passport size photograph on the application form and put your signature half on the photograph and half on the form. Attach self-attested copies of required certificates including Birth Certificate, qualification certificates, 15 years Residence Certificate in Goa, Employment Card, Aadhaar Card, Experience Certificate, and EWS Certificate if applicable. Ensure all fields are correctly filled and required documents are enclosed. Submit the application in the prescribed format by post or hand delivery to the Managing Director, Goa Housing Board, Building 'A', 2nd Floor, New Market Complex, Porvorim, Bardez, Goa - 403521 latest by 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the Goa Housing Board Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by the Goa Housing Board to fill 2 civil engineering posts under advertisement number GHB/ADM/1708 /2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies: 1 for Assistant Engineer (Civil) and 1 for Junior Engineer (Civil).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Junior Engineer (Civil)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognized University / State Board or equivalent, along with knowledge of Konkani.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 45 years, with relaxations applicable for Government servants and reserved categories as per Government orders.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for Goa Housing Board Recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications in the prescribed format offline along with self-attested documents to the office of the Managing Director, Goa Housing Board, Porvorim, Bardez, Goa.

faq.question: Q8. What are the pay scales for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The Assistant Engineer (Civil) post is in Level-7, and the Junior Engineer (Civil) post is in Level-5.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Junior Engineer post permanent?
faq.answer: The post of Junior Engineer (Civil) is against a lien vacancy.
